text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.19 for the Senior Software Engineer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications is their experience with "Python" and the possession of a computer science degree. However, the application has significant gaps, including a lack of experience with vue.js, node.js, react, and aws, as well as having 1.5 years of experience compared to the implied 4-year requirement. This profile was escalated for manual review despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements.
